issues.detail: Rule condition says GHR shifts when predict_valid and (train_valid==0 or train_valid==1 but not mispredicted), but spec S14 says training takes precedence over prediction whenever both occur, not only on misprediction.
issues.spec_evidence: When this happens, training takes precedence, because the branch being predicted will be discarded anyway.

issues.detail: Spec says recover GHR to state immediately after mispredicting branch completes; contract says restore to train_history shifted with train_taken. Alternative: restore exactly to train_history (the provided post-branch history), not shifted.
issues.spec_evidence: recover the branch history register to the state immediately after the mispredicting branch completes execution.
issues.alternative: GHR <= train_history exactly (no additional shift by train_taken)

issues.detail: Spec does not state PHT counter update policy (increment/decrement vs set to taken/not-taken). Contract assumes saturating increment/decrement toward train_taken; alternative is direct set to 2'b11/2'b00.
issues.spec_evidence: Update the pattern history table (PHT) to train the branch predictor to predict this branch more accurately next time.
issues.alternative: PHT entry set directly to 2'b11 if train_taken else 2'b00

issues.detail: Spec does not define predict_taken encoding for 2-bit counter (e.g., MSB vs counter>=2). Contract example only shows 0; alternative: predict_taken = counter[1] (MSB).
Spec does not state which direction bit is shifted into GHR on prediction (predicted taken vs actual). Contract assumes predicted direction; alternative: shift in predict_taken.
issues.spec_evidence: The branch history register is then updated (at the next positive clock edge) for the predicted branch.

issues.detail: Spec says async active-high reset but does not specify reset values for PHT/GHR or outputs. Contract assumes zeros; alternative: GHR=0, PHT all 2'b01 (weakly not-taken).
issues.alternative: On areset: GHR=0, all PHT entries=2'b01

issues.detail: Spec S16 references a timing diagram for simultaneous train/predict of PHT entry 0; no explicit waveform/table is provided in indexed spec, so cannot derive/compare.
issues.spec_evidence: The following timing diagram shows the timing when training and predicting PHT entry 0 at the same time.

issues.detail: Rule example expected outputs are all zero and do not exercise nonzero PHT/GHR; no verbatim evidence for example values.
